core_categories: Medical and Surgical Products; Personal Protection and Apparel; Diagnostic and Exam Products; IV and Injection Supplies; Laboratory and Testing Items; Facility and Janitorial Supplies
specialty_focus: Claflin Company is a full-line wholesale distributor of medical and surgical products, founded in 1817. It specializes in advanced healthcare logistics, custom inventory management (Just-in-Time delivery), and third-party logistics through its Advanced Logistics Management (ALM) division. It supplies hospitals, clinics, and medical facilities with a broad range of medical and surgical product lines, but does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
